name: pointer-highlight
blurb: Content highlights with glowing border and pointer indicator following cursor.
description: Wraps content in a glowing border rectangle with a pointer/cursor indicator that tracks mouse position, creating a highlighted interactive zone.
use_when: Hero text, CTAs, or key content where glowing highlights with cursor tracking draw attention and guide interaction.
a11y: Visual highlight only; no semantic enhancement. Focus and keyboard access depend on child content.
